summary: Sudden 5xx surge for Dedicated tenant during autoscaler scale-down; TLS handshake backlog correlated with runtime preempts
description: Issue summary: BrightRetail observed a sharp rise in 5xx responses for their Dedicated tenancy (brightretail-prod) from 09:12-09:47 UTC on 2026-03-13. API gateway returned intermittent 502/503 and some requests timed out. Impact: approximately 30% of inference requests failed for ~35 minutes, disrupting product recommendation flows at checkout. Environment: Dedicated pool on A100-80GB nodes with autoscaler configured to aggressively scale down (idle_threshold=90s).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Simulate a sustained 200 qps inference workload pinned to redwood/guanaco-8b-quant from tenant brightretail-prod in eu-west
2) Allow autoscaler to scale down to minimum nodes (observe idle_threshold behavior)
3) Trigger short background job spikes from client that open TLS connections but do not complete quickly
4) Observe apigw handshake latencies and runtime container exits during node drain

2026-03-13T09:13:10Z runtime-22: container PID=2211 exited code=137 signal=SIGKILL model=redwood/guanaco-8b-quant

2026-03-13T09:14:07Z apigw: TLS handshake delay avg_ms=480 baseline_ms=45 rate_per_s=18 tenant=brightretail-prod

investigation_notes: 09:20 UTC - Initial hypothesis: aggressive autoscaler scale-down raced with in-flight connections causing TLS handshake backlog at apigw; backlog coincided with node drain events.
09:32 UTC - Correlation found: TLS handshake latency increase preceded runtime container exits by ~40-90 seconds. Handshake backlog overlapped with node-45 drain window.
09:40 UTC - SRE (Priya Singh) captured traces: elevated tcp_retransmit counters on node-45 and kernel scheduler preempt logs during 09:13-09:16.
09:52 UTC - Customer confirmed a concurrent client-side deploy and short connection bursts at ~09:10 that increased surface load.

Working theory: scale-down initiated while apigw still had active TLS handshakes; connection backlog and transient kernel-level network delays caused timeouts, subsequent runtime restarts, and amplified 5xx rates.
Checked recent changes: autoscaler config altered in ops-pr 5901 to reduce min node counts for cost savings; no runtime code rollouts in the window.

action_items: Apply temporary mitigation: set autoscaler idle_threshold=300s for brightretail-prod in eu-west
Implement apigw connection-drain guard during node eviction to allow pending TLS handshakes to finish
Run controlled load test with warmed KV caches to validate behavior before wider rollout
Post-incident: revise autoscaler defaults for dedicated low-latency tenants and update runbook
